title: Domains & Platforms Model
description: Visual map of the Application Domains & Platforms Catalogue (APP-DAP), arranged as a nested card diagram: application domains as groups, platforms as items within each group. Derived from APP-DAP rather than authored directly.

meta.description: A visual map of the organisation's application landscape.
purpose: Give a single-page view of the application landscape, grouped by application domain.
Provide a shared reference point for application rationalisation and investment discussions.
Provide an embeddable diagram for presentations, kept in sync with APP-DAP.
